info.name: FoC D3 Demo (Order + Credit async via Gateway)
info.description:
AI-influenced: Postman collection and polling scripts authored with Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.8); see ai/usage-log.md.

Milestone D3 demo of the Order Service and Credit Service and their async (RabbitMQ/outbox) workflows, exercised end-to-end through the API Gateway (http://localhost:8080), no UI. Folders 00-11 run top to bottom; every email embeds a per-run runId so the whole collection is re-runnable with no manual steps. Auth is a per-request Bearer token (never raw X-User-* headers; the gateway strips those and injects identity from the JWT). Async terminal states are reached by polling (GET re-issues itself via setNextRequest, capped, failing loudly on timeout). OTP codes are read from Mailpit. See postman/README.md.
